ns2:section.sectionText: "INTRODUCTION TO JAZZ" Joan B. Hickey, Instructor http://www.music.uiuc.edu/facultyBio.php?id=43. Introduces students to the art form of jazz by linking the development of the music to the historical and social events of the United States in the 20th century. Seeks to develop the student's musical ear by focusing on some of the innovators of jazz through the use of recordings and DVDs. Includes live performances. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
